# Dungeon wall torch attribution

“Dungeon wall torch” by [UriZX](https://sketchfab.com/UriZX), downloaded from
[Sketchfab](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/dungeon-wall-torch-1439096bf4414ff9bbd615a4c727fbff)
on 2026-08-26.

Licensed under [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
Commercial use, modification, and redistribution with attribution are permitted by
this license.

Sketchfab offered the original model as OBJ (4 MB), USDZ (1 MB), glTF (2 MB), and GLB
(2 MB, 1K textures). BROcoli retains the downloaded GLB source. Its SHA-256 digest is
`2e0cc6089a3cb72a9f21102d5cf27a8d4e650b009af6dda29f8ee3303d972feb`.

The source mesh has 3,283 vertices and 4,470 triangles. For BROcoli it was prepared in
Blender 5.2.1 LTS: transforms were applied, the origin was moved to the wall-mounting
plane and bottom of the model, and the mesh was validated while preserving its supplied
UVs and normals. No decimation was needed because it is below the 5,000-triangle budget.
The model was exported to FBX, its 1K base-color, emission, and normal textures were
extracted, and glTF metallic/roughness channels were repacked for Unity's
metallic/smoothness convention.

Required attribution: “Dungeon wall torch” by UriZX, licensed under CC BY 4.0.
